verdict.rationale: First-party docs name webhook events across the agentic commerce lifecycle. These include catalog-import outcome events (v2.commerce.product_catalog.imports succeeded / succeeded_with_errors / failed), a per-order checkout.session.completed event, the delegated_checkout.requested_session.completed webhook for embedded checkout, and webhooks for each shared payment token state transition (e.g. shared_payment.issued_token.used). This clearly covers the core of event subscription for agent-driven flows. Missing for 10: documentation of the subscription mechanics (registering endpoints, selecting events, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees), and independent or hands-on corroboration that these webhooks are delivered.
